note: geometry measured on PEMM00 from a live frame of cn.flytalk.tetris.nearme.gamecenter (2026-10-10). Cell classification uses max(RGB) above `brightness_threshold`; colours still need a frame with pieces in play.

measured.source: adb screencap 720x1600 + pixel projection over the hypothesised playfield
measured.verified_by: ASCII board shows a plausible stack (empty top rows, blocks at the bottom) and the vision model confirms a tetris board with stacked blocks

mechanics.note: The game can switch the drop direction mid-session (切换掉落方向) and defines custom shapes (定义方块). gravity_options is the axis set this skill can play and must match simulator.GRAVITIES; shapes is the app's custom shape set as 0/1 bitmaps, empty until a live session records it - the simulator accepts any mask, so nothing needs recompiling when it is filled in.
